title: Karbala waale yaad aayenge
body:
Karbala... Karbala..(4)
<<MINI>>
Paani pyaaso ko jab pilaoge, karbala waley yaad aaenge..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani pyaaso ko jab pilaoge....
1. Koi marjata hai kisi ka agar
kandha dete hai log aake magar
sheh ne tanha uthai laashe pisar
jab jawaa koi laash uthaoge..
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Karbala mein bana tha jo dulha
kya muqaddar tha uski dulhan ka
shab ko dulhan thi subha ko bewa
betiyo ka jo ghar basaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali asghar ki maa pe nazre thi
ran mein yu teer kha ke roya nahi
maa pareshaan ho na jaye kahin
zakhm khaa kar jo muskuraoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Baap bichhda tha jab sakina se
har qadam par use tamache lage
koi deta na tha tasalli use
jab yateemo pe tars khaaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek beti jahaa'n me hai sughra
qabr tak jiska intezaar gaya
jiska baba na laut kar aaya
ghar mein pardes se jab aaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haaye muslim ke wo pisar dono
eid ke din the dar ba darr dono
yaad karte the apna ghar dono
eid apno mein jab manaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jab janaza batool ka uttha
sabr us dam ali ka kaisa tha
girya zainab ke saamne na kiya
aansu bacho se jab chhupaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aisa dekha nahi ghareeb koi
bus ye ghurbat hai sirf Mahdi ki
qabr e zehra hai abhi tooti hui
qabr pe maa ke jab bhi jaaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Hai takallum payam e sabr yahi
karbala dil mein gar tumhare rahi
tum pe mushkil padhegi jab bhi koi
apne ghum saare bhool jaoge
<<MINI>>
karbala waley yaad aaenge...
Paani pyaaso ko jab pilaoge, karbala waley yaad aaenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala... Karbala..
